notes.title: Hell Builder Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Hell Builder is out now on Steam! Construct your own underworld empire in this unique roguelike city builder that combines card-based strategy with devilish city planning.[/p][p]If you played the demo before, the full game has [b]5 Unique Dark Lords[/b]. Each one offers a unique vision with their own exclusive buildings and playstyles to master. Plus, their own challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681933/5e5b2473d9a1807a60fa900008e82d8883758ef6.png"][/img][/p][h2]Special Launch Discount - Limited Time![/h2][p]To celebrate the release of Hell Builder, we're offering a special launch discount! Save on your journey to infernal mastery - but hurry, this offer ends on [b]August 20th[/b]. Don't miss your chance to build your dark empire at a reduced price![/p]
